name: join
description: Connects to Join (join.build), the preconstruction and design phase platform, through the Join MCP server, and adds skills for working with Join project data, such as a one-page A3 executive snapshot and a risk and contingency analysis of a project.

interface.longDescription: Work with your Join projects: look up projects, milestones, cost totals, items, risks and history, add comments and items, build a one-page A3 executive snapshot of a project, and run a risk and contingency analysis (Cost Risk Calculator waterfall and Monte Carlo range of outcomes).
defaultPrompt: Build an A3 snapshot of my Join project for the owner's executive sponsor
Is the contingency on my Join project enough to cover where it will land?
What are the biggest open cost risks on my Join project?
